title: Static-host (GitHub Pages) QR pairing
reason: Discovered work (per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Major but self-resolvable discovered work'): phone pairing built in 2b.1–2b.4 assumed the laptop runs a local Vite dev server that serves /phone over the LAN. When the app is served from the public GitHub Pages deployment (under a base path, vite base: './'), the offer QR pointed the phone at https://<laptopLanIp>/phone — a non-existent server — so the phone hung on a blank page. The user reported this and authorized fixing it as its own phase.
numbering: Appended as 2b.5 under the existing Phase 2b phone-as-sensor decomposition. No already-approved phase was renumbered (PHASES.md operating rule preserved).
supersedes: Relaxes the implicit 2b.1 assumption that the phone loads /phone from the laptop dev server. The legacy /phone path remains supported for local dev (backward compatible); the QR now emits a host-agnostic hash-role URL on the laptop's current origin.
planning_gate: Triggered (cross-layer: routing + URL construction + UI; public-internet exposure). decision-memo.md §'Phase 2b.5 — Static-host QR pairing' written; architecture-red-team + code-reviewer invoked and findings resolved.
scope_note: WebRTC DataChannel remains peer-to-peer with STUN only (no TURN). Accepted connectivity scope: same non-isolated LAN. Cross-network / guest-isolated / symmetric-NAT pairing is explicitly out of scope and surfaced via a connection-timeout diagnostic.
project_complete_status: The prior phase-6.3 project_complete:true signal stands for the MVP feature set; this is a post-completion deployment fix, not a new MVP feature.
